描述_EN: posters helped to propagate the cult and here he is seen literally as the central subject. mao zedong's personal aim behind the cultural revolution was to bolster his own position within the communist party. chairman mao badges and posters offered a means for people to 'own' the cult and demonstrate their allegiance. a 'saturation campaign' of visual propaganda was a primary vehicle for disseminating the new ideologies. through the upheaval of the cultural revolution (1966-1976) mao zedong aimed to reinvigorate communism in china and eliminate traditional urban class differences. themes and form were rigidly prescribed and the idealised figures were often copied from source books.
描述_ZN: 海报帮助宣传邪教，在这里他被看作是中心主题。 毛泽东在文化革命背后的个人目的是为了加强他自己在共产党内的地位。 毛主席徽章和海报为人们提供了一种 "拥有 "邪教并展示其忠诚的方式。 视觉宣传的 "饱和运动 "是传播新意识形态的主要工具。 通过文化大革命（1966-1976）的动荡，毛泽东旨在重振中国的共产主义，消除传统的城市阶级差异。 主题和形式是严格规定的，理想化的人物往往是从原始书籍中复制的。
